name: Adversarial hinge objectives
description: Separate discriminator relu(1-real)+relu(1+fake) and generator -fake score objectives; caller owns detach/gradient routing.

examples.title: Train DCGAN with adversarial hinge
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def real_images(ctx):
 return {"x": synth.Tensor(torch.rand((1, 16, 16), generator=ctx.rng.torch) * 2 - 1)}
ds = synth.Spec("hinge-gan", generator=real_images, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("gan", split="train", preserve_shape=True)
generator = build("dcgan-generator", "tiny", latent_dim=4, out_channels=1, image_size=16, features=4)
discriminator = build("dcgan-discriminator", "tiny", in_channels=1, image_size=16, features=4)
trainer = Trainer(generator, train, recipe="gan", components={"discriminator": discriminator}, optimizers={"generator": "adam", "discriminator": "adam"}, recipe_config={"loss": "adversarial-hinge", "latent_dim": 4, "image_channels": 1, "image_size": 16}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
